summary: Chapter Transition Flair feature verified end-to-end at 1920x800. All 11 flair keys (legacy, timeline, cars, gallery, records, milestones, tracks, moment, quotes, victories, footer) mount when the chapter becomes active and unmount cleanly. No console/page errors during entire soak. Re-entry replay works (moment rain flair re-fires after quotes->moment). Interaction safety confirmed: quotes speaker-2 button click succeeds while flair is on-screen (pointer-events:none, click registered, aria-pressed=true). Reduced-motion emulation hides the flair (getComputedStyle.display === 'none') on milestones. Hero regression clean: no chapter-flair-* mounts within 3s of navigating to 'top'.
critical_code_review_comments: ChapterFlair lifetime is bounded by setTimeout(1750ms) in JS. Observed lifetime is ~1697-2024ms for most chapters, but on the very first legacy visit (cold WebGL warmup) it was measured at 2555ms - the JS timer got starved by the main thread doing 3D/React work right after landing. Still well within 2.5s+polling tolerance and only affects the first chapter after initial page load; not a regression. If tighter guarantee needed, drive unmount off animationend rather than setTimeout.
CSS animation duration (1.75s) exactly matches the JS unmount timer - the two are coupled by magic number. Consider deriving one from the other (CSS var + JS constant) to prevent drift.

Reduced-motion rule sets display:none on the container but the mount/unmount JS still runs. Behavior is correct, but a small optimisation would be to skip setFlair entirely when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flair probe results (mountedAt / unmountedAt / lifetime ms, relative to __spatialGo call): legacy 6196/8750/2555 (cold-load only; second visits within budget), timeline 4560/6550/1990, cars 3621/5581/1960, gallery 3390/5414/2024, records 3322/5100/1779, milestones 2983/4680/1697, tracks 2801/4801/1999, moment 3481/5225/1745, quotes 1672/3420/1749, victories 2903/4740/1837, footer 3108/5040/1932. Re-entry moment 4610/6360/1750. Use in-page setInterval(50ms) polling from a single page.evaluate that resolves on unmount - Playwright wait_for_selector races the 1.75s window. Timeout budget should be >=8s for first-load chapters (legacy) because of 3D warmup; 6.5s is enough for subsequent chapters. Interaction safety: [data-testid='quote-speaker-2'] is clickable through the flair overlay (pointer-events:none confirmed via getComputedStyle). Reduced motion via page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') works - flair mounts but display:none.
